name_en: House of Distinguished Health Service Worker

summary_en: On 6 October 1981 Jerzy Popiełuszko took over pastoral care of the sick at the House of Distinguished Health Service Worker at Elekcyjna 37, setting up chapels there and becoming chaplain by curial appointment.
